note: Every number the recommendation ranking uses. Edit this file and reload the app - no code change, no restart of anything but the server. Scores start at base_score and move from there; the final value is clamped to 0-100. Raise a number to make that factor matter more.
_base_score: Where every listing starts before anything is known about it.

budget._what: Scored against the REAL monthly cost, not the advertised rent. This is the heaviest factor on purpose: being over budget is the one thing that rules a place out.
budget._under_budget_base: Credit for simply fitting the budget at all.
budget._under_budget_per_budget_fraction: Extra credit scaled by how much headroom there is, as a fraction of the budget. Headroom of 20% of budget adds 0.20 x 60 = 12.
budget._over_budget_per_budget_fraction: Penalty scaled by how far over, as a fraction of budget. 10% over costs 0.10 x 110 = 11.

value_vs_baseline._what: How the listing's gross rent compares with U.S. Census rents for its own census tract and bedroom count.
value_vs_baseline._implausible_below_pct: Below this, a listing is treated as suspect rather than cheap. Same threshold as SCAM-PRICE-TOO-GOOD in ct_rental_rules.json; in this snapshot it catches eight per-room prices quoted as whole-unit rent. Keep the two files in step if you change it.

commute._what: Walking minutes to the address the person typed, from a straight-line distance with a detour allowance.
commute._within_limit_per_minute_spare: Credit per minute under the stated limit. A 20 min limit met in 12 min adds 4 + 8 x 0.8 = 10.4.
commute._long_walk_warning_minutes: Above this, with no car, adds a warning but no score change.

requirements._what: Things the person explicitly asked for.
requirements._spare_bedrooms_warn_at: Bedrooms beyond household size before warning that the price may be per room. No score change - spare rooms are neither a benefit nor a fault.
requirements._laundry_unknown_penalty: Deliberately harsher than on-site: not knowing is worse than knowing something mediocre.

calendar_gap._what: Months of rent paid before the person arrives, from the June-lease / August-arrival mismatch.

completeness._what: How much the advertisement actually states. A ranking built on guesses should rank below one built on facts.
